data.row_key_policy: Ad-hoc SQL rows do not receive synthetic keys; select stable identity columns such as __report_label, ids, names, start, and end when rows must be cited or compared.
data.sql: SELECT n.text AS phase, (n."end"-n.start)/1e6 AS wall_ms FROM NVTX_EVENTS n WHERE n.text LIKE '%.rows128.parzen.repeat1' ORDER BY phase LIMIT 10

data.row_key_policy: Ad-hoc SQL rows do not receive synthetic keys; select stable identity columns such as __report_label, ids, names, start, and end when rows must be cited or compared.
data.sql: SELECT n.text AS phase, names.value AS api, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(a."end"-a.start)/1e6 AS host_ms FROM NVTX_EVENTS n JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME a ON a.globalTid = n.globalTid AND a.start >= n.start AND a."end" <= n."end" JOIN StringIds names ON names.id=a.nameId WHERE n.text LIKE '%.rows128.parzen.repeat1' GROUP BY n.text, names.value ORDER BY phase, host_ms DESC LIMIT 100

data.row_key_policy: Ad-hoc SQL rows do not receive synthetic keys; select stable identity columns such as __report_label, ids, names, start, and end when rows must be cited or compared.
data.sql: SELECT n.text AS phase, names.value AS kernel, COUNT(*) AS launches, SUM(k."end"-k.start)/1e6 AS gpu_ms FROM NVTX_EVENTS n JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME a ON a.globalTid = n.globalTid AND a.start >= n.start AND a."end" <= n."end" JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_KERNEL k ON k.correlationId=a.correlationId AND k.globalPid=((a.globalTid >> 24) << 24) JOIN StringIds names ON names.id=k.shortName WHERE n.text LIKE '%.rows128.parzen.repeat1' AND (names.value LIKE '%devBP%' OR names.value LIKE '%batch_backproject%') GROUP BY n.text, names.value ORDER BY phase LIMIT 10

data.sql: SELECT n.text AS phase, m.copyKind AS copy_kind, COUNT(*) AS copies, SUM(m.bytes) AS bytes, SUM(m."end"-m.start)/1e6 AS gpu_ms FROM NVTX_EVENTS n JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_RUNTIME a ON a.globalTid = n.globalTid AND a.start >= n.start AND a."end" <= n."end" JOIN CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND_MEMCPY m ON m.correlationId=a.correlationId AND m.globalPid=((a.globalTid >> 24) << 24) WHERE n.text LIKE '%.rows128.parzen.repeat1' GROUP BY n.text, m.copyKind ORDER BY phase, bytes DESC LIMIT 20
